title: untucked dreams seeping in broken seems team in demons of unseen clucks of broken clocks who can't STOP TICKING!! #smallpoems
summary: untucked dreams seeping in broken seems team in demons of unseen clucks of broken clocks who can't STOP TICKING!! #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
untucked
  dreams
seeping in
   broken seems
team in demons
  of unseen
      clucks of
broken clocks
   who can't
          STOP
                 TICKING!!
#smallpoems
